gloss: from place to place; wandering; changing repeatedly

definitions.gloss: from place to place; wandering about
definitions.explanation: Moving repeatedly from one location to another.
Passing from one owner or possessor to another multiple times.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}めて→求める：02316_motomeru⟧{転々|てんてん}とした。
examples.english: I wandered from place to place looking for work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{転々|てんてん}と⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}えている→変える：01089_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: He keeps changing his address repeatedly.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{転々|てんてん}と⟦{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}→持ち主：10439_mochinushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}えてきた→変える：01089_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: This painting has changed hands many times.

examples.japanese: ⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{転々|てんてん}と⟦{旅|たび}した→旅：03407_tabi⟧。
examples.english: I traveled from place to place.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{転々|てんてん}と⟦{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}→持ち主：10439_mochinushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
⟦{盗品|とうひん}→盗品：28317_touhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{転々|てんてん}と⟦{売|う}りさばかれた→売りさばく：28318_urisabaku⟧。
examples.english: The stolen goods were sold from person to person.

notes:
{転々|てんてん} is a reduplication of ⟦{転|てん}→転：noentry⟧ (to roll; to turn; to change), describing repeated movement or transfer.

USAGE:
- {転々|てんてん}とする (to wander from place to place)
- {転々|てんてん}と⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧ (to change repeatedly)
- {転々|てんてん}と⟦{暮|く}らす→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧ (to live moving from place to place)
This word often implies instability or restlessness - someone who can't settle down or something that keeps getting passed around.

WATCH OUT:
⟦{点々|てんてん}→点々：03974_tenten⟧ - has the same reading but different meaning (here and there; dotted about). Different kanji.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {転々|てんてん} (rolling/moving repeatedly)
- ⟦{点々|てんてん}→点々：03974_tenten⟧ (scattered dots)
